sentences.text: In short: IKOMM AS is an established medium-sized company in "datainfrastruktur, -behandling, -lagring og tilknyttede tjenester" based in Lillehammer, profitable in 2025 and with no open NAV job ads under its org number.
IKOMM AS describes itself on its website as: "For kommuner, bedrifter og deg - Ikomm leverer sikker og stabil IT-drift for offentlige og private aktører. Vi sørger for at teknologien jobber for deg".
IKOMM AS is a private limited company (AS), founded on 2007-05-14, registered in Lillehammer.
It has 167 registered employees, reported revenue of NOK 493.33M for 2025 and an operating result of NOK 1.93M (2025).
Its 2025 accounts show an operating margin of 0.4% and a moderate equity ratio of 22% of total assets.

Revenue rose 15.0% from 2024 to 2025 (NOK 429.13M to NOK 493.33M); it was NOK 328.41M in 2023. The annual result went from a loss in 2024 to a profit in 2025 (2023: -NOK 10.17M, 2024: -NOK 5.90M, 2025: NOK 831,457).
IKOMM AS is led by CEO Morten Kristoffer Rønning and board chair Vegar Strand.
It has a board of 7. The register last recorded a change to its roles on 2026-07-13 (within the past year).
IKOMM AS has a verified website (https://www.ikomm.no/), 2 linked public profiles and 2 registered workplaces.
